name: Chiselgrip
summary: Chiselgrip is an outpost maintained by the Thorium Brotherhood southwest of the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes. Positioned dangerously close to Dark Iron and Blackrock territory, it serves as a staging ground for covert operations against the mountain's hostile occupants.

sections.title: Heart of the Steppes
sections.body: Perched in the charred expanses of the Burning Steppes, Chiselgrip acts as an forward enclave for the Thorium Brotherhood. Unlike their brethren sheltered in the Searing Gorge, the dwarves here operate in the immediate shadow of Blackrock Mountain and the sprawling Ruins of Thaurissan. The settlement provides basic amenities—including working forges maintained near Stebben Oreknuckle and regional flight connections—to support daring expeditions into enemy encampments. Operatives here coordinate deep infiltrations against the Blackrock clan, offering neutral shelter to any capable traveler willing to turn the screws on the local warlords.

faq.answer: Chiselgrip is a neutral Thorium Brotherhood encampment located southwest of the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes. It serves as an outpost and operational hub for subversive efforts targeting the Blackrock clan.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde visit Chiselgrip?
faq.answer: Yes. Because Chiselgrip is maintained by the Thorium Brotherhood, it welcomes both Horde and Alliance adventurers who are willing to aid their efforts in the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: What services are available at Chiselgrip?
faq.answer: The camp features flight connections to nearby outposts like Flamestar Post, Morgan's Vigil, and Flame Crest. It also provides equipment repair via Hoddruc Bladebender and functioning forges overseen by Stebben Oreknuckle.

faq.q: What operations are run out of this camp?
aliases: what do you do in chiselgrip
faq.answer: The outpost primarily stages covert strikes, reconnaissance, and sabotage against the nearby Blackrock clan and the ruins of Thaurissan, often utilizing disguises and golems to infiltrate enemy holdings like Black Tooth Hovel.

angles.text: The camp features active forges maintained by Stebben Oreknuckle, providing a welcome workstation deep within the hostile steppes.
For dwarves, seeing Thorium Brotherhood kin carving out a foothold right outside the ruined seat of Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan is a stark reminder of their race's fractured, volcanic past.
